method: Fresh compiler processes and rebuilt output; warm filesystem caches; wall and CPU times include process startup, source counting and shutdown.
source_counting: Physical loaded source lines, including blanks/comments and unused lazy library bodies. Dewy and implementation source are separate. Loaded lines/second is input throughput, not fully checked/emitted lines/second. Small programs primarily measure latency, not the 250k LOC/s target.
scope: Language conformance stress workload, not a representative game. Distinct existing cases, no repeated padding. Every case is called and its result checked once outside timed compilation. Includes generated driver and imported library source; counts are reported separately. Fresh processes/outputs with warm filesystem caches.
